sentence_text: this is the full text of circular number 001 from the ministry of finance.
it discusses new tax regulations for the upcoming fiscal year.
all businesses are required to comply with these changes by march 1st.
circular 002 from the central bank addresses revised interest rates.
the new base rate will be 5.25% effective immediately.
banks are advised to adjust their lending rates accordingly.
this measure aims to stabilize inflation and support economic growth.
an addendum to circular 001 has been issued regarding the implementation of tax regulations.
small businesses with annual turnover below a certain threshold are granted a 3-month extension for compliance.
new guidelines for listed companies on quarterly reporting.
companies must submit their financial statements within 45 days of the quarter-end.
emphasis is placed on transparency and accurate disclosure of financial performance to protect investor interests.
the central bank has released a circular on digital currency regulations.
financial institutions engaging in digital asset transactions must adhere to strict kyc and aml procedures.
this move is to mitigate risks associated with new financial technologies.
